items.name: ExtensionTypeRegistration
items.summary: The registration of an extension type. Implementations of this trait are responsible for *creating* instances of [`DFExtensionType`] that represent the entire semantics of an extension type.

methods.name: create_df_extension_type
methods.signature: fn create_df_extension_type(&self, storage_type: &DataType, metadata: Option<&str>) -> Result<DFExtensionTypeRef>
methods.summary: Creates an extension type instance from the optional metadata. The name of the extension type is not a parameter as it's already defined by the registration itself.

methods.name: new_arc
methods.signature: fn new_arc(name: impl Into<String>, factory: impl Fn(&DataType, Option<&str>) -> Result<DFExtensionTypeRef> + Send + Sync + 'static) -> ExtensionTypeRegistrationRef
methods.summary: Creates a new registration for an extension type. The factory is required to validate that the storage [`DataType`] is compatible with the extension type.

methods.name: type_name
methods.summary: The name of the extension type.

methods.name: all_extension_types
methods.summary: Returns a list of all registered types.

methods.name: new_empty
methods.summary: Creates an empty [MemoryExtensionTypeRegistry].

methods.name: new_with_canonical_extension_types
methods.summary: Pre-registers the [canonical extension types](https://arrow.apache.org/docs/format/CanonicalExtensions.html) in the extension type registry.

methods.name: new_with_types
methods.signature: fn new_with_types(types: impl IntoIterator<Item = ExtensionTypeRegistrationRef>) -> Result<Self>
methods.summary: Creates a new [MemoryExtensionTypeRegistry] with the provided `types`.
